approval: User: RanPAC 재측정까지 포함하여 추천안대로 진행.
class_order: Natural CIFAR100 order 0..99; first task classes 0..9
method_settings: Preserve each method's accepted native optimizer, learning rates, scheduler and task-boundary algorithms; run one training epoch.
auxiliary_costs: Include full Fisher, feature/SVD/GPM, prototype, random-projection and ridge operations in their actual task phases.
input_policy: Compare actual raw sample/order and train/test transform fingerprints; common transform recipe does not imply identical stochastic crop realizations across historical pipelines.
repeat_policy: Three fresh measurement processes with the same seed; a fourth separate partial-FLOPs process is excluded from resource statistics.
accuracy_policy: Actual predictions/counts, finite gradients, frozen weights, complete stream/update/task state checks and accuracy strictly greater than20% detect collapse. Abnormally low accuracy requires investigation. This one-epoch pilot is separate from matched 20/30-epoch source verification and its1.5/3.0pp thresholds.
measurement_scope: Recorder interval includes initialization, data loading, begin/train/end, evaluation and audits/checkpoint. Final W&B artifact upload/finish is excluded. GPU board energy excludes CPU/RAM/system power; FLOPs are partial supported-operator estimates.
historical_limits: Historical measurements have different dates/source snapshots/phase budgets. EASE CPU thread count was not recorded and stays unknown. RanPAC gets four fresh runs rather than reusing its overwritten historical train-transform metadata.
task1_limits: No task2 KD/old-branch interactions or long-term forgetting/growth are estimated. HiDe uses TII1+prompt1 and two statistics passes; one epoch is not equal compute.
